policy: didactic decision support, not validated clinical score or medical prescription

anchors.5: piccoli trial umani con forti limiti
anchors.7: piu trial coerenti con limiti moderati
anchors.10: evidenze cliniche solide, coerenti e direttamente applicabili

benefit_magnitude.requires: outcome numeric, absolute/relative change, dose, comparator, population; else null

anchors.1: forma o dose profondamente diversa dagli studi
anchors.10: forma, dose e durata coincidenti con evidenza pertinente

anchors.4: evento che può richiedere modifica o interruzione
anchors.10: evento potenzialmente letale o danno irreversibile

risk_likelihood.requires: incidence or comparable pharmacovigilance data, otherwise null

anchors.5: etichetta nota ma analisi non documentate
anchors.10: tracciabilita, controlli lotti e test pertinenti verificati

traffic_light_note: color is metric-specific; yellow also for unknown but displayed as grey question mark, not as numeric middle value

decision_logic.step_2: screen red flags (contraindications, potential interactions, pregnancy, quality doubts)
decision_logic.step_3: check quality of evidence and study-product match
decision_logic.step_4: compare benefit and risk dimensions separately
decision_logic.step_5: if evidence is insufficient return NON CLASSIFICABILE; never fill missing scores
decision_logic.step_6: show reasoned explanation and citations, not medical advice
